title: Sigma correlation rule test cases
description: Schema for the *.test.yaml sidecar that accompanies each Sigma correlation rule. A correlation is evaluated over a sequence of events and a timespan, so the fixture carries `windows` rather than the single-event `cases`.

name.description: Human readable description of the scenario.

expect.description: Whether the correlation is expected to fire on these events.

events.description: Ordered normalized telemetry events evaluated as a sequence.
